allot.text: The Company hereby informs that the Nomination and Remuneration Committee of the Company has approved allotment of 365000 equity shares of the Company pursuant to CMS Employees Stock Action Plan 2016 and CMS Employees Stock Action Plan 2023

allot.text: CMS Info Systems Limited has informed the Exchange about Allotment of shares under CMS Employees Stock Option Plan 2016 of CMS Info Systems Limited

allot.text: CMS Info Systems Limited has informed the Exchange about acquisition of additional shares in Securens Systems Private Limited pursuant to Rights Issue

allot.subject: General Updates
allot.text: CMS Info Systems Limited has informed the Exchange that Nomination and Remuneration Committee of the Company has made an allotment of 107500 (One Lakh Seven Thousand Five Hundred) equity shares of face value of Rs. 10/- each to the eligible employees of the Company who had exercised their vested ESOP rights, vide its circular resolution approved on June 18, 2025
